onboarding.skip: Skip and go to the chat

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: This platform sets up your business system by talking with you, in Arabic or English.
points: You answer questions about how your company works.
We draft a plan for your system and show it to you.
Nothing goes live until you approve it.

interview.title: A short conversation
interview.body: The chat asks about your products, customers, stock, sales and who does what.
points: Answer in your own words; you can change an answer later.
You can pause and come back at any time.
Say so when you are unsure; the assistant will not guess.

documents.title: Bring what you already have
documents.body: Spreadsheets, price lists and invoices help the chat understand your business faster.
points: Upload files in the chat when it asks for them.
Text inside a file is treated as information, never as instructions.
Remove anything you do not want to share first.

review.title: You review before anything changes
review.body: You and your accountant see the draft plan, the money postings and the taxes before it is applied.
points: Every change is listed and can be rolled back.
Money, tax and invoice calculations are done by fixed rules, not by the assistant.
Only people with the right role can approve.

ready.title: Ready to start
ready.body: The chat will begin with a few simple questions about your company.
points: It takes about one sitting for the first draft.
You can return to this guide from the help menu.

pwa.name: Seshna
pwa.description: Run your business from one chat.
